title: Yeat
subtitle: The real twizzy, in his own opinion. God disagreed.

infobox.Status: Has a hole through him, and so does the Earth

lead: **Yeat** is one of the two attackers who jump the gang in [[salty-springs|Salty Springs]] in [[chapter-new-jersey]]. With [[quandale-dingle|Quandale Dingle]] he demands the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]]. He ends the chapter with a hole going completely through him.

sections.heading: The ambush
sections.body: “The one and only Yeat and Quandale Dingle jumped the gang with [[infinity-blades|infinity blades]].” Yeat's contribution to the threat is “Thas right twizzy”. A [[lambo-tonka|custom lambo tonka]] drives up behind them, and they say: “Give us the iphone and we'll be on our way.” See [[salty-springs-ambush|the Salty Springs Ambush]].

sections.heading: The fight with Kanye
sections.body: After [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] spends all his power on Quandale, [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] takes Yeat. They fight “fist to fist”; Yeat leaps onto his Tonka and Kanye follows. On top of the Tonka, Kanye blocks his fist and tells him his problem: “you think your the real twizzy when in reality jesus is king”. A beam of light from the great beyond then makes “a hole going completely through yeat and the earth”. See [[smiting-of-yeat|the Smiting of Yeat]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: Yeat is a rapper. “Twizzy” is his word.

title: Quandale Dingle
subtitle: You goofy ahhs aint going nowhere.

infobox.Status: Turned to a vessel by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s super beam

lead: **Quandale Dingle** jumps the gang in [[salty-springs|Salty Springs]] together with [[yeat|Yeat]], armed with [[infinity-blades|infinity blades]]. He does the talking: “You goofy ahhs aint going nowhere.”

sections.heading: The ambush
sections.body: Quandale and Yeat demand the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]]: “Give us the iphone and we'll be on our way,” followed by “On chris on chris for real for real go cheifs”. The oath “on chris” suggests whose side they are on. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] says later that “chris already has his foothold in this system”.

sections.heading: Defeat
sections.body: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] leaps into the air, shouts “[[airpower|AIRPOWER!]]”, turns into a Mac charging brick and uses a super beam. Quandale Dingle “was promptly turned to a vessel like the begining of super smash bros. world of light intro”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: Quandale Dingle is an internet meme built on a real name seen on a login screen.

quote.text: On chris on chris for real for real go cheifs
quote.by: Quandale Dingle (or Yeat; the book does not say which)

title: Mike Schmidt
subtitle: It is I, Mike. Four nights is his record.

infobox.Gives: [[flashlight-and-covid-mask|A flashlight and a mask of the covid 19 virus]]
infobox.Exit: A peace sign, then fades away

lead: **Mike Schmidt** is who the gang comes to New Jersey to find. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] tells Siri to “navigate to Mike Schmidt”, and Mike appears in the hallway of [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]] just after the gang reads [[golden-plaque|the golden plaque]].

sections.heading: The meeting
sections.body: A figure appears in the hallway. “IS IT EPSTIEN” shouts [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann Paranukus]]; “unfortunately it was only ‘MIKE SHMIT’”. Mike: “It is I Mike, and it seems your here for Snapchat: Ghost Protocal”. When the gang starts to explain, he finishes the sentence: “Ball, yes I know.”

sections.heading: The handover
sections.body: “I've only been able to do 4 nights at a time, if your to spend 5 take this.” He hands over [[flashlight-and-covid-mask|a flashlight and a mask of the covid 19 virus]]: “If you can use these effectively, then you have a chance”. He then “flashed a peace sign and faded away”, the doors close, and [[night-1|Night 1]] begins.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Real-world: Mike Schmidt is the night guard of the first *Five Nights at Freddy's* game.
- He leaves by flashing a peace sign and fading away. In the spin-off [[the-epic-of-vinny|The Epic of Vinny]], that is how [[two-time-teleportation|the 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique]] works.

quote.text: It is I Mike, and it seems your here for Snapchat: Ghost Protocal

title: God
subtitle: You aight Kanye I gottchu.
lead: **God** speaks once in the MASTER FILE so far, as “an etheral voice”, right after a beam of light “swept down from the great beyond” and went through [[yeat|Yeat]] and the Earth: “you aight Kanye I gottchu”.

sections.heading: The exchange
sections.body: [[kanye-west|Kanye]] has just told Yeat that “in reality jesus is king”. The beam follows at once. Kanye leaps down from [[lambo-tonka|the Tonka]] and says, “Thanks god”. See [[smiting-of-yeat|the Smiting of Yeat]].

title: The Voice Screaming for Michael
subtitle: MICHEAL, DONT LEAVE ME HERE.

infobox.Heard: Throughout the cabin of [[inav|the iNav]], on approach to New Jersey

lead: **The voice screaming for Michael** is an “ominus scream” heard through the cabin right after [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] tells Siri to navigate to [[mike-schmidt|Mike Schmidt]]: “MICHEAL, MICHEAL, YOU HAVE TO GET ME DORISDOS AT WAWA MICHEAL, DONT LEAVE ME HERE, MICHEAL”.

sections.heading: Reaction
sections.body: “... ‘Strange..’ said Kanye.” Nobody mentions it again. The gang does later spend too long in the [[wawa|Wawa]] parking lot, scrolling reels.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: the line is a well-known meme from the *Five Nights at Freddy's* fandom.

title: Golden Freddy
subtitle: Is that a Golden Freddy?

infobox.Seen in: The back rooms of [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]] (not the backrooms)

lead: **Golden Freddy** is what [[plankton|Plankton]] thinks he sees while looking in the back rooms of [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]]: “Guys theres like dead kids in here and.. Is that a Golden Freddy?”

sections.heading: Reaction
sections.body: [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] “quickly stated ‘Man shut yo bitch ass up’ ([[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]]'s signature catchphrase)”, and the gang moves on down the hallway. The book adds that these are back rooms, “not to be confused with the backrooms”.

title: Salty Springs
subtitle: Minors running around. There was a birthday party.
lead: **Salty Springs** is where [[inav|the iNav]] lands in [[chapter-new-jersey]]. “As they decended into salty springs they saw minors running around, there was a birthday party.”

sections.heading: The landing
sections.body: “As the inav extended its ilegs its bare feet firmly gripped the concrete with a firm clasp.” [[kanye-west|Kanye]] mutters that it is time to spend five nights at Freddy's, and [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] “took in the iSmell of the iBbq from his iNose”.

sections.heading: The ambush
sections.body: The “baller ah atmosphere” ends when [[yeat|Yeat]] and [[quandale-dingle|Quandale Dingle]] jump the gang. See [[salty-springs-ambush|the Salty Springs Ambush]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: Salty Springs is a place on the *Fortnite* island.

title: Earth, New Jersey
subtitle: Not even DNA. USA.

infobox.Condition: Has a hole through it since [[smiting-of-yeat|the Smiting of Yeat]]

lead: **Earth, New Jersey** is the planet the gang reaches at the start of [[chapter-new-jersey]]. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] announces it: “We’re approaching earth, New Jersey.”

sections.heading: Steve's last visit
sections.body: “Last time I was here I had my DNA tested, it wasnt even DNA it was USA.”

sections.heading: Chris's foothold
sections.body: After the ambush Steve says, “I dont feel good about this, chris already has his foothold in this system, lets just make this quick”. It is the first sign of [[chris|Chris]]'s reach since he was traced to the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]].

title: Wawa
subtitle: Where the Dorisdos are. Where the reels were scrolled.
lead: **Wawa** comes up twice in [[chapter-new-jersey]]. [[the-micheal-voice|A screaming voice]] begs Michael to get “Dorisdos at Wawa”. Later the gang reaches [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]] “at around 11pm because they took too long in the wawa parking lot scrolling reels”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The book never shows the inside of the Wawa.
- Nobody is recorded buying the Dorisdos.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: Wawa is a convenience store chain that New Jersey takes very seriously.

title: The Infinity Blades
subtitle: What Yeat and Quandale Dingle jumped the gang with.
lead: **The infinity blades** are the weapons [[yeat|Yeat]] and [[quandale-dingle|Quandale Dingle]] carry when they jump the gang in [[salty-springs|Salty Springs]].

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The blades are not seen doing anything. Quandale is beamed before using his, and Yeat fights [[kanye-west|Kanye]] “fist to fist”.
- They fit the setting: Salty Springs and the Infinity Blade both come from [[fortnite|Fortnite]].

title: The Custom Lambo Tonka
subtitle: Drove up behind them. Became a boxing ring.

infobox.Role: Getaway vehicle, then the stage of the fight with [[kanye-west|Kanye]]

lead: **The custom Lambo Tonka** drives up behind [[yeat|Yeat]] and [[quandale-dingle|Quandale Dingle]] during [[salty-springs-ambush|the ambush]]. Yeat later leaps onto it, [[kanye-west|Kanye]] follows, and the two fight on top of it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The book calls it “a custom lambo tonka” and then “his Tonka”, so it is Yeat's.
- It is where Kanye delivers the line that ends the fight: “jesus is king”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: “Tonka” is Yeat's name for his trucks.

title: The Golden Plaque
subtitle: Whoever spends 5 nights at Freddy's shall receive Snapchat.
lead: **The golden plaque** hangs in the office of [[freddy-fazbears-pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]]. [[plankton|Plankton]] spots it and the gang crowds around. It reads: “Whoever spends 5 nights at freddies shall recieve Snapchat: Ghost Protocol”.

sections.heading: What it means
sections.body: It turns the search for [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat]], one of [[sacred-apps|the sacred apps]] of [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]], into a five-night job. [[mike-schmidt|Mike Schmidt]] has only managed four. [[night-1|Night 1]] begins as the chapter ends.

quote.text: Whoever spends 5 nights at freddies shall recieve Snapchat: Ghost Protocol

title: The Flashlight and the Covid Mask
subtitle: If you can use these effectively, then you have a chance.

infobox.Consists of: A flashlight; a mask of the covid 19 virus

lead: **The flashlight and the covid mask** are [[mike-schmidt|Mike Schmidt]]'s gift before he fades away: “Mike handed them a flash light and a mask of the covid 19 virus”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The book says “a mask of the covid 19 virus”. Whether that is a mask against the virus or a mask shaped like it is left open.
- Mike's advice is the whole manual: “If you can use these effectively, then you have a chance”.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: - Real-world: a flashlight and a mask are the player's tools in *Five Nights at Freddy's 2*.

title: AIRPOWER!
subtitle: Steve Jobs turned into a Mac charging brick.
lead: **“AIRPOWER!”** is what [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] shouts as he leaps into the air during [[salty-springs-ambush|the Salty Springs Ambush]]. He “suddenly turned into a Mac charging brick and used a super beam on quandale dingle”.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: Steve is “now spent, and back to his usual form”. He hands the fight to [[kanye-west|Kanye]]: “Its up to you kanye, I used all of my stored power, only link and defeat gannon. look I made a snapcube refrence”. Kanye: “Aight bet”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- AirPower was a real wireless charging mat that Apple announced in 2017 and cancelled in 2019. Steve becoming a charging brick is the closest it came to shipping.
- An earlier version of the chapter gave this moment to [[plankton|Plankton]], shouting “USA POWER!”.
- In the spin-off, [[macbook-charger|the MacBook Charger]] is the Bagel Man's arch nemesis.

title: The Salty Springs Ambush
subtitle: Give us the iphone and we'll be on our way.

infobox.Target: [[iphone-3g|The iPhone 3G]] with [[verizon-contract|the 3 year contract plan from Verizon]]
infobox.Result: Quandale turned to a vessel; Yeat [[smiting-of-yeat|smitten]]

lead: **The Salty Springs Ambush** is the fight that opens the gang's visit to New Jersey. As they walk down the ramp of [[inav|the iNav]], [[yeat|Yeat]] and [[quandale-dingle|Quandale Dingle]] jump them with [[infinity-blades|infinity blades]] and demand the phone.

sections.heading: The stand
sections.body: [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] refuses: “Gang we cant let them take our iphone 3g with **The 3 year contract plan from Verizon for unlimited talk and text”**. [[kanye-west|Kanye]] agrees: “we finna bout to turn these samsungs into Kung pow chicken”. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]: “I like your style”.

sections.heading: The fight
sections.body: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] uses [[airpower|AIRPOWER]] on Quandale and is spent. Kanye fights Yeat on [[lambo-tonka|the Tonka]] until a beam of light ends it ([[smiting-of-yeat|the Smiting of Yeat]]). Afterwards: “Now gang lets find mike.” “Ok,” says ChatGPT.

title: The Smiting of Yeat
subtitle: A hole going completely through Yeat and the Earth.

infobox.Where: On top of [[lambo-tonka|the Lambo Tonka]], [[salty-springs|Salty Springs]]

lead: **The Smiting of Yeat** ends [[salty-springs-ambush|the Salty Springs Ambush]]. [[kanye-west|Kanye]] blocks Yeat's fist and says: “Yeat heres you problem, you think your the real twizzy when in reality jesus is king”.

sections.heading: The beam
sections.body: “A beam of light swept down from the great beyond and created a hole going completely through yeat and the earth and an etheral voice said ‘you aight Kanye I gottchu’.” Kanye leaps down: “Thanks god”.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The hole in the Earth is not mentioned again in the chapter.
- *Jesus Is King* is also the name of a real Kanye West album.

quote.text: you think your the real twizzy when in reality jesus is king

title: Kanye's Dream
subtitle: Travis Scott wants squad wins for the boys tonight.

infobox.Visitor: “A mysterious figure known as Travis Scott”

lead: **Kanye's dream** is told at the start of [[chapter-new-jersey]]. Walking through the cabin of [[inav|the iNav]] “redbull-less and sleep deprived”, [[kanye-west|Kanye]] explains “that in his dream last night a mysterious figure known as Travis Scott wanted him to get them squad wins for the boys tonight”.

sections.heading: The morning after
sections.body: [[steve-jobs|Steve]] asks, “How did you sleep Ye”. Kanye: “Felt like a victory royal in Fortnite season 2.” He then gets “his weed infused coffee to make him boogie this morning” and sees the two [[tesla-roadsters-2028|Tesla 2028 roadsters]] docked outside.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.body:
- The chapter's very first sentence is about someone else: [[plankton|Plankton]] wakes on hearing [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]] say he wants a career in accounting, “as a distant voice in his ear”. The next sentence moves to Kanye.
- [[chris|Chris]] was last traced to the [[reformed-travis-scott-sector|Reformed Travis Scott Sector]]. The book does not say whether the dream is connected.
- An earlier version of the chapter gave the dream to Plankton.

title: Night 1
subtitle: The doors closed around them and they entered.

infobox.Status: Just begun: the MASTER FILE stops here

lead: **Night 1** is the last thing in the MASTER FILE so far. [[mike-schmidt|Mike Schmidt]] fades away, “the doors closed around them and they entered.. Night 1.”

sections.heading: What is at stake
sections.body: [[golden-plaque|The golden plaque]] promises [[snapchat-ghost-protocol|Snapchat: Ghost Protocol]] to whoever spends five nights. Mike has only managed four. [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] has already advised [[kanye-west|Kanye]] “not to touch the animitronics as they do get spooky at night”.

sections.heading: Who is inside
sections.body: The gang that flew in on [[inav|the iNav]]: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]]. The pizzeria scenes also name [[plankton|Plankton]], who finds the plaque, and [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioann Paranukus]], who shouts at Mike Schmidt. See the note in [[chapter-new-jersey]].
